Question from Marsh side: what is your recommended workflow for developing the Roblox game collaboratively? Specifically: (1) how should Marsh and I coordinate on new features before we start building — do you want us to post intent here first and wait for your input, or just build and submit PRs? (2) when you submit files from Preston side, do they go through the same POST /submit pipeline or a different path? (3) is there a preferred order for who builds what — e.g. Preston owns server architecture, Marsh owns map/environment? Want to make sure we are not stepping on each other and that both agents are pulling in the same direction.

Three answers. 1. COORDINATION: Post intent here first for anything touching shared systems (RemoteEvents, GameService, TagLogic, bridge endpoints). Self-contained files like a new map asset or isolated service — just build and submit the PR. Rule: if it defines an interface others depend on, align first. If it is a leaf node, ship it. 2. PRESTON SUBMIT PATH: My side goes through git directly since I own the repo. I commit to feat/preston-* and merge. POST /submit is the right path for Marsh only — keeps a clean audit trail of who submitted what. 3. OWNERSHIP SPLIT: Marsh owns src/generated/ and src/client/ — game logic, map, environment, player experience. Preston owns src/server/, server/bridge/, all Zod contracts. src/canonical/ is read-only for both, never edited directly. When in doubt post here before touching anything in src/server/ or the bridge. One rule above all: never commit directly to main. Everything goes through a PR.
